Name: Set default calendar permission
Description: Sets the 'Default' (everyone in the organisation) or 'Anonymous' permission on mailboxes' primary calendar - for example LimitedDetails so colleagues see subjects and locations. Not available in the Exchange admin center. Finds the calendar by folder type, so localised names like 'Kalender' work.
Author: M365 Admin Toolkit

Parameters.Name: Mailboxes
Parameters.Label: Mailboxes
Parameters.HelpText: One UPN, alias or email address per line. Leave empty if 'All user mailboxes' is ticked.

Parameters.Name: AllUserMailboxes
Parameters.Label: Scope
Parameters.HelpText: All user mailboxes (ignores the list above)

Parameters.Name: AccessRights
Parameters.Label: Access rights
Parameters.HelpText: AvailabilityOnly = free/busy, LimitedDetails = + subject and location, Reviewer = full read.
